authorityBoundary: Workspace-owned local operation templates only. Resolve adopted catalog IDs/revisions immediately before a separately approved write.

materializationContract.atomicResolution: Resolve masterKey to the target workspace catalog item ID and current catalog revision after V4 adoption.
materializationContract.nestedResolution: Resolve dependency templateKey to the orderSetId and currentRevisionId returned by its earlier create operation.
materializationContract.conflictPolicy: Never overwrite. On conflict, re-read current state and require a newly approved manifest.
